target_scope: annotation-derived semantic transitions; progression is a proxy
prediction_selection: actual-next: all eligible VAL tokens; h0: known stable VAL tokens
detection_selection: threshold: maximum VAL building-macro recall under FPR<=0.05 with deterministic ties; epoch: descending downstream VAL building-macro F1 then earlier epoch; patience resets only on strictly improved F1
gallery_policy: fixed event-ID order plus highest common-support errors; shared TRAIN/VAL scales
fusion_selection: TRAIN masked BCE with equal building weights; select highest VAL building-macro F1 at recall-maximizing FPR<=0.05 threshold; earlier epoch breaks ties
checkpoint_retention: unique union: top3 F1 and best IoU/recall/applicable NLL/A semantic mIoU; latest contains full resume state
